visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a bustling urban street with a prominent runner billboard in the background. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white scarf and black coat, stands holding a baby dressed in pink and white. A pair of hands enters the frame from the left, holding up a decorative light-blue and cream-colored bag with a large gold bow. (2) The visual cuts to a quick montage showing the woman's hands working on a white table indoors, cutting white fabric and using a white sewing machine. She holds up a plain white canvas bag before the scene transitions back to the street. (3) Back on the street, the woman is now using the modified bag as a harness for the baby, who is being held upright by the bag's handles as she walks. A young boy in a green Luigi costume with a matching hat stands next to them, holding a small object. (4) The camera follows the woman and baby as they walk through a crowded plaza. The woman smiles and looks down at the baby, who is wearing a white knit hat and the harness. The lighting is bright and natural, suggesting daytime in a city center.
